sections.body:
### Exercise 1 — Add "Spam" and a confidence score

Extend `Classification` with a fourth category `"Spam"` and a `confidence: float` field. Print a warning when confidence is below 0.6.

<details>
<summary>Solution</summary>

```python
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv()

from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_ai import Agent

class Classification(BaseModel):
    category: Literal["Work", "Personal", "Urgent", "Spam"] = Field(
        ..., description="Classification bucket."
    )
    reason: str
    confidence: float = Field(..., ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="0.0 to 1.0")

agent = Agent(
    model="openai:gpt-4o-mini",
    system_prompt="Classify the message as Work, Personal, Urgent, or Spam.",
    result_type=Classification,
)

result = agent.run_sync("CONGRATS YOU WON a free iPhone!!! Click here")
c = result.data
print(c)
if c.confidence < 0.6:
    print("WARNING: low-confidence classification, consider manual review.")
```

</details>

### Exercise 2 — Switch to Anthropic Claude

Recreate the classifier using `anthropic:claude-3-5-sonnet-latest`. Confirm it works without changing the `Classification` model.

<details>
<summary>Solution</summary>

```python
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv()

from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_ai import Agent

class Classification(BaseModel):
    category: Literal["Work", "Personal", "Urgent"]
    reason: str

agent = Agent(
    model="anthropic:claude-3-5-sonnet-latest",
    system_prompt="Classify the message into Work, Personal, or Urgent.",
    result_type=Classification,
)

print(agent.run_sync("My flight lands at 9pm, can you grab me?").data)
```

Make sure `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is set in `.env`. The model string format is always `provider:model-name`.

</details>

### Exercise 3 — Print token usage

After classifying three messages, print total request and response tokens consumed across all three calls.

<details>
<summary>Solution</summary>

```python
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv()

from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic_ai import Agent

class Classification(BaseModel):
    category: Literal["Work", "Personal", "Urgent"]
    reason: str

agent = Agent(
    model="openai:gpt-4o-mini",
    system_prompt="Classify the message into Work, Personal, or Urgent.",
    result_type=Classification,
)

samples = [
    "Pick up dry cleaning please",
    "Prod is down!",
    "Review the PR by EOD",
]
total_req = total_resp = 0
for s in samples:
    r = agent.run_sync(s)
    u = r.usage()
    total_req += u.request_tokens or 0
    total_resp += u.response_tokens or 0
    print(r.data.category, "-", s)

print(f"\nTotal request tokens: {total_req}")
print(f"Total response tokens: {total_resp}")
print(f"Total tokens: {total_req + total_resp}")
```

`result.usage()` returns a `Usage` dataclass with `requests`, `request_tokens`, `response_tokens`, and `details`. Fields may be `None` for some providers, so guard with `or 0`.

</details>
